questions.q: Why didn't Passepartout answer the first time Fogg called him?
choices: He was asleep in his room upstairs
It was not the right hour for his master to be home
He was busy turning off the gas lamps down in the kitchen
He did not hear the call over the noisy rain
questions.evidence: It could not be he who was called; it was not the right hour.

questions.q: How did Passepartout react when Fogg said they were going round the world?
choices: He laughed, thinking it was a joke
He cheered loudly and began to pack at once with joy
He was overcome with stupefied astonishment
He refused to go and asked to quit
questions.evidence: so overcome was he with stupefied astonishment

questions.q: What luggage did Fogg say they would take?
choices: Two large trunks of clothes and shoes
Only a carpet-bag with a few shirts and stockings
A trunk each and a box of books
Nothing at all, since they would buy everything on the way
questions.evidence: We'll have no trunks; only a carpet-bag

questions.q: While packing, what thought cheered Passepartout a little?
choices: He might get to see France and Paris again
He would earn much more money on the trip
He could finally ride in a first-class train
He would no longer have to follow the daily card
questions.evidence: it would do his eyes good to see Paris once more

questions.q: What did Fogg put into the carpet-bag before they left?
choices: His whist cards and a pocket almanac
A roll of Bank of England notes
A loaded pistol and some cartridges
Letters of introduction to foreign banks
questions.evidence: slipped into it a goodly roll of Bank of England notes

questions.q: What did Fogg do with the twenty guineas he had won at whist?
choices: He gave them to a poor beggar-woman
He paid the cabman at Charing Cross
He bought two first-class tickets
He left them at home in his safe

questions.q: What did Fogg tell his friends at the station they could check when he got back?
choices: His Bradshaw's guide with every train marked
The carpet-bag and the money left in it
His passport, to prove he made the journey
Passepartout's diary of the whole long trip
questions.evidence: if you will examine my passport when I get back

questions.q: As the train passed Sydenham, what did Passepartout suddenly remember?
choices: He had left Fogg's mackintosh in the cab
He had forgotten to turn off the gas in his room
He had not locked the street-door of the house
He had left his silver watch on the mantel
questions.evidence: To turn off the gas in my room!
